payload.claim: DataCamp certifications are now accredited and recognised for academic credit

payload.claim: DataCamp learning method is more hands-on for data topics
payload.quote: If your goal is to clearly upskill in data, AI, programming or analytics, and you have a tight budget, then DataCamp could be a great option, especially since their learning method is more hands on for these subjects.

payload.claim: Coursera offers certificates with top universities and companies
payload.quote: Coursera offers degrees and certificates in collaboration with top-notch universities and companies—think John Hopkins University, Yale, Google, Microsoft, NYU, Oxford, Stanford, and the list goes on.

payload.claim: Auditing a Coursera course gives no completion certificate
payload.quote: However, if you choose to audit the course (learn for free), you won’t receive credits nor a completion certificate.

payload.claim: edX has no subscription plans, pay per course

payload.claim: Coursera Plus costs 79 a month or 599 a year
payload.quote: Coursera Plus, the all-access subscription that unlocks all three certificates, now runs $79 a month or $599 a year, and a monthly plan keeps billing for every month you fall behind schedule.

payload.claim: Only around 12% of people finish MOOCs

payload.quote: Coursera's own estimate for the IBM program is roughly eight months at 10 hours a week, which stretches to well over a year and a half at five hours a week.
